interpretation.relations: 以 v3.1.0 关系表的 Source、Relation、Target 为准；保留 Relation 原名。
interpretation.sources: TreatmentPlan 统一为 Treatment Plan；Communication 统一为 Communication Strategy，与节点表一致。
interpretation.legacy: 旧实体、属性和关系保留供导入及修订；新版不再允许的类型或端点组合标为已弃用，不自动改写语义。

definitions.graph: Entity: exact normalized label/name. Relation: directed endpoint label/name and relation. Name normalization is NFKC, casefold and whitespace only; no synonym inference.
definitions.ner: Exact section, start/end character offsets, source text and entity label.
definitions.nel: NER match plus the same supplied concept ID.
definitions.m_re: Directed source mention text/type, relation label, target mention text/type; offsets do not enter the relation key.
definitions.c_re: Directed source concept ID/type, relation label, target concept ID/type.
definitions.aggregation: Deduplicate within each document. Micro sums counts; macro F1 averages categories with reference support. Relation categories are source type, relation, target type. No overlap-merging is applied.
definitions.failures: Missing, failed or invalid graphs count as empty predictions; all reference items remain false negatives. Invalid prediction items count as false positives.
definitions.interpretation: Scores measure agreement with the declared reference, not independent clinical correctness or evidence support.
